```yaml
name: Release Scrapers

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Create SCRAPE variable
        run: echo "SCRAPE=dune exec" >> $GITHUB_ENV

  scrape:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Install pre-built scraper binary
        uses: jaxxstorm/action-install-gh-release@6096f2a2bbfee498ced520b6922ac2c06e990ed2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          repo: ocaml/ocaml.org
          tag: scraper-latest
          asset-name: scrape.exe

      - name: Run scraper
        run: ./scrape.exe

  scrape_platform_releases:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Install pre-built scraper binary
        uses: jaxxstorm/action-install-gh-release@6096f2a2bbfee498ced520b6922ac2c06e990ed2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          repo: ocaml/ocaml.org
          tag: scraper-latest
          asset-name: scrape.exe

      - name: Run scraper for platform releases
        run: ./scrape.exe --platform-releases
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up the necessary environment, installs the pre-built scraper binary from the `scraper-latest` release, and runs the scraper using the `SCRAPE` variable set to `dune exec`. The workflow includes two jobs: one for scraping general information and another for scraping platform-specific releases.
